description: Check a design against the Mzizi floors. Colours: the WCAG 2.x contrast ratio of a foreground on a background (#RRGGBB), with the AA-large, AA and AAA verdicts and whether it meets the Mzizi floor of 7:1. Spacing: pass any of `insetPx` (text to container edge), `controlGapPx`, `labelGapPx`, `itemGapPx` (gaps) and `leading` (body line height) and each is compared with the spacing floor the pinned registry states (nothing may go under it): the spacing floor (14px inset, 7px gaps between controls, 7px between a label and its field, 7px between items, 1.5 body leading). Give colours, spacing values, or both. Computed locally, no network. It does not compute APCA Lc or simulate colour-vision deficiency; read the Mzizi accessibility doctrine (mzizi_get_tokens family=accessibility) for those rules. To check a project's source rather than values, run `mzizi check` (@nyuchi/mzizi-cli).

background.description: Background colour as #RRGGBB, e.g. #FFFFFF. Give with foreground.

controlGapPx.description: Gap between adjacent interactive controls, visible edge to visible edge, in px.

foreground.description: Foreground colour as #RRGGBB, e.g. #1B1A17. Give with background.

insetPx.description: Padding between text and its container edge, in px.

itemGapPx.description: Gap between sibling items in a list, grid or toolbar, in px.

labelGapPx.description: Gap between a label and its field, in px.

leading.description: Body line height as a unitless ratio, e.g. 1.5.

name: mzizi_check_accessibility
title: Check accessibility
